title: Getting one value out: nums[0]
idea: To pick a single value out of a list by its position, use square brackets with a number: nums[0] gives the FIRST value. Positions start at 0.

exercises.prompt: You have nums = [3, 7, 2]. To pull out ONE value by its position, you write the list name and a number in square brackets. Which gets the first value?
exercises.explanation: Square brackets after the name pick a value by position: nums[0]. The number inside is the position, and the first position is 0.
Position 0 is the FIRST value, which is 3. Indexing gives you one value, not the whole list.

exercises.prompt: In a list, the first value is at position 0, not position 1.
exercises.explanation: Yes — this surprises everyone at first. Counting starts at 0, so the first value lives at index 0.
Position 0 is 3, position 1 is 7. So nums[1] gives the SECOND value, 7.

exercises.prompt: For nums = [3, 7, 2], match each index to the value it gives.
exercises.explanation: Positions go 0, 1, 2 for a three-value list. The index picks out the value sitting at that position.

exercises.prompt:
Complete the line to print the first value of nums:

nums = [10, 20, 30]
print(nums[____])
exercises.explanation: The first value sits at index 0, so nums[0] gives 10. Remember: counting starts at zero.

exercises.prompt: What does indexing like nums[1] GIVE you?
options: A single value from the list
How many values the list has
exercises.explanation: Indexing reaches in and pulls out one value — the one at that position. The rest of the list stays untouched.
Positions: 0 is 5, 1 is 8, 2 is 2. So prices[2] gives the value 2, the third one.

exercises.prompt: nums[0] and nums mean the same thing.
exercises.explanation: No. nums is the whole list; nums[0] is just the one value at position 0. The brackets with a number pick a single item.

exercises.prompt: scores = [90, 85, 70]. Which line prints the SECOND score, 85?
exercises.explanation: The second value sits at index 1 (because the first is index 0). So scores[1] is 85. You just indexed a list on purpose!
